On this walk you understand early modern memorial space, material craft and patronage.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Neighbourhood entry orientation

  • Stone craft close observation

How the time is spent

  1. Neighbourhood entry orientation 15 min

Nizamuddin, Delhi
